action: Renamed 7 kept CPCB columns from 'NAME (unit)' to short names; dropped the other 18 columns (gases, VOCs, rain, radiation, pressure)
reason: Units belong in the data dictionary, not in column names; the dropped variables are not part of the question

action: Parsed CPCB 'Timestamp' text into datetime (IST, start of hour)
reason: Text dates cannot be sorted or joined; 0 values failed to parse

action: Kept only 15 Sep - 30 Nov of each year (CPCB)
reason: Outside the study window

action: Kept only the PM2.5 parameter from OpenAQ
reason: Other pollutants and weather are outside the question

action: Converted OpenAQ ISO timestamps (with +05:30 offset) to plain IST to match CPCB
reason: The two sources must use the same clock before they can be compared

action: Removed the numeric suffix (e.g. '-3379575') and 'New Delhi' -> 'Delhi' in OpenAQ station names
reason: So that names can be compared with CPCB's spelling

action: Dropped exact duplicate OpenAQ readings (same sensor and time)
reason: A reading should appear once

action: Kept only 15 Sep - 30 Nov 2025 (OpenAQ)
reason: Outside the study window

action: Averaged OpenAQ 15-minute readings into hourly means
reason: CPCB reports hourly averages; both sources need the same time step

action: Converted CPCB station wind speed from m/s to km/h (x 3.6)
reason: Open-Meteo wind is in km/h; one unit per quantity

action: Checked CPCB for repeated station-hours
reason: Each station-hour should appear once

action: Cross-source: OpenAQ hours that duplicate a CPCB value for the same station-hour were dropped (CPCB kept)
reason: Same station, same hour, same measurement in two sources

action: OpenAQ location 11607 matched no CPCB station and was dropped
reason: Not one of our stations

action: Filled empty CPCB hours (2025) with the matched OpenAQ hourly mean
reason: Same instrument's data published through a second channel

action: Merged 'Pusa, Delhi - DPCC' and 'Pusa, Delhi - IITM' into one site 'pusa' (hourly mean of the two)
reason: Same location under two names; keeping both would double-count the site

action: Set PM2.5 to missing where flag = impossible_value
reason: PM2.5 of zero or below cannot be real

action: Set PM2.5 to missing where flag = stuck
reason: Frozen sensor: same value 4+ hours

action: Set PM2.5 to missing where flag = isolated_spike
reason: Single-station jump not seen elsewhere

action: Kept city-wide high values (flag = citywide_high_kept)
reason: Real events seen at many stations at once (Diwali nights, smog episodes)

action: Flagged (not changed) hours where PM2.5 exceeds PM10 by more than 10 ug/m3
reason: Physically impossible if both are right; the two run on separate instruments so we cannot tell which is wrong - PM2.5 kept, PM10 not used in analysis

action: Linear interpolation of PM2.5 gaps of 3 hours or less
reason: Short gaps in a smooth series; data are MAR

action: Left longer PM2.5 gaps empty (not imputed)
reason: Filling long gaps would invent data and could hide or create peaks
